messages.subject: INLA latent variables more than 15
parts:
Hi INLA helpdesk,

I am trying to implement a model where I have 16 covariates and I want to use all of them individually as random effect with same graph and besag model. In my case I have created 16 same ID as ID1=ID2=...=ID16 as 16 same ID columns. Now my model is,


Y~
f(ID1,x1,model=besag",...)+
f(ID2,x2,model=besag",...)+
f(ID3,x3,model=besag",...)+
+
.......

+
f(ID16,x16,model=besag",...)

But in my experience as it is 16 many hyperparameters, it is taking very long time. Is there any was specific so that I can ensure that the corresponding hyperparameters are same so that it is a bit faster?

Alokesh.
